landing.tagline: The smarter way to study technical content
landing.heroDescription: The only platform that unifies reading, annotation, AI study tools, flashcards, and analytics in a single distraction-free experience.
landing.heroDescriptionAlt: A distraction-free reading platform with notes, bookmarks, highlights, and analytics — built for serious learners who want to retain more.
landing.problemDescription: Most students use a reader + note app + flashcard app + analytics tool + AI assistant separately. LearnBook unifies everything into one seamless workflow.
landing.problemFragmentedDesc: No more switching between Kindle, Notion, Anki, and ChatGPT
landing.problemHighlightsDesc: Your highlights become flashcards that you actually review
landing.problemPassiveDesc: AI quizzes and study sessions turn reading into active recall
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to learn effectively
landing.featuresSubtitle: Purpose-built tools to keep you focused and help you retain more.
landing.featuresSubtitleAlt: Purpose-built tools to keep you focused and track your progress.
landing.featureReaderDesc: Beautiful reading experience with customizable fonts, themes, and reading width. Your content, your way.
landing.featureNotesDesc: Take contextual notes tied to chapters, sections, or text selections. Highlight and annotate everything.
landing.featureAnalyticsDesc: Track progress, streaks, reading speed, and focus time. Set daily and weekly goals.
landing.featureAiDesc: Select any text to get AI explanations. Summarize chapters, ask questions — all grounded in your content.
landing.featureFlashcardsDesc: Generate flashcards from highlights with FSRS scheduling. Review smarter, remember longer.
landing.featureKnowledgeDesc: Visualize how concepts connect across chapters and courses. See the big picture of your learning.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From reading to mastery in 4 steps
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: A complete study loop — no app switching, no manual exports.
landing.howItWorksSubtitleAlt: From upload to insights in minutes — no setup required.
landing.stepImportDesc: Upload Markdown, PDF, EPUB, or paste a URL. We parse it into a structured, annotatable format.
landing.stepReadDesc: Enjoy a focused reader with notes, bookmarks, highlights, and AI explanations on any selection.
landing.stepReviewDesc: AI generates flashcards from your highlights. FSRS scheduling ensures you review at the optimal time.
landing.stepTrackDesc: Detailed analytics show your reading speed, streaks, and knowledge gaps. Set goals and hit them.
landing.advancedTitle: And much more under the hood
landing.advMultiFormatDesc: Import Markdown, PDF, EPUB, or web articles. One reader for all your study material.
landing.advGroupsDesc: Create groups, share annotations, discuss per-chapter, and compete on leaderboards.
landing.advQuizDesc: Interactive Socratic sessions that quiz you, identify weak areas, and auto-create flashcards.
landing.advSearchDesc: Find anything across chapters, notes, and sections in milliseconds with Cmd+K.
landing.advStreakDesc: Build consistent study habits with daily streaks, weekly goals, and activity heatmaps.
landing.advPrivacyDesc: Your data stays yours. No ads, no tracking, no selling your reading habits.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to transform your study workflow?
landing.ctaDescription: Join learners who've replaced 5 apps with one. No credit card required.
landing.ctaDescriptionAlt: Join thousands of readers and start your first course today. No credit card required.
landing.faqFormatsA: Markdown, PDF, EPUB, and web articles via URL import. All formats are parsed into our annotatable reader.
landing.faqAiQ: How does the AI study assistant work?
landing.faqAiA: Select any text to get contextual explanations. Ask questions about the chapter, generate flashcards, or start an interactive quiz — all grounded in your actual content, not generic answers.
landing.faqFsrsA: FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) is a modern algorithm that adapts flashcard review intervals based on your performance — proven superior to Anki's SM-2 algorithm.
landing.faqGroupsA: Yes! Create study groups, share highlights and notes, discuss per-chapter, and compete on weekly leaderboards.
landing.faqPrivacyA: Absolutely. We don't sell your data, show ads, or track your reading habits. Your notes, highlights, and reading data belong to you.
landing.faqCancelA: Yes. All paid plans include a 14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime from your profile — no questions asked.
